products.contentHtml:
PVC Fresh Food Hand Wrap

Keep fresh food presentation simple. This hand roll is intended for wrapping produce trays and covering food containers at supermarket counters and catering preparation areas. The clear film lets staff and customers see the contents without opening the wrap.

Product features

  • Clear appearance for visible food presentation.
  • Flexible film that follows tray edges and container shapes.
  • Hand-roll format for counters where pack sizes change throughout the day.

Specification and ordering

Send the tray dimensions, preferred roll width and estimated daily consumption. We will confirm film thickness, roll length, core size and carton quantities for your order.

Request a quotation

Send your required quantity, roll specification, packaging artwork and destination to YIYUAN. We will confirm the available configuration, packing details and quotation for your purchase.

Organize frequent wrapping tasks with a boxed roll at the preparation station. The dispenser format brings the film and its packaging together for repeated use when covering bowls, food trays and prepared ingredients.

products.contentHtml:
PVC Large Roll Cling Film

Plan roll supply around the capacity of your wrapping station. This large-roll format offers an alternative to small retail rolls for buyers who need to define roll diameter, core dimensions and handling requirements at the quotation stage.

Product features

  • Large roll format with a clearly accessible paper core.
  • Transparent PVC film for viewing wrapped contents.
  • Roll and transport packaging specified together to suit the order.

Specification and ordering

Send the roll width, required film thickness, roll length or net weight, core diameter and maximum outside diameter. If using equipment, include its model and roll limits so compatibility can be checked before supply.

Request a quotation

Send your required quantity, roll specification, packaging artwork and destination to YIYUAN. We will confirm the available configuration, packing details and quotation for your purchase.
